subject: MAP / legal sequencing & orderform gating — Cardinal Diagnostics
messages:
From: Amelia Torres <amelia.torres@cardinaldx.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@cardinaldx.com>, procurement@cardinaldx.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial MAP request & gating questions for purchase

Neha — thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement has asked for a short mutual action plan (MAP) that ties the evaluation milestones to legal/ordering gates so we can present to leadership on Friday. Key asks from our side:

- Clear dependency list: MSA signature, DPA execution, order form + PO acceptance.
- Evidence we can present: SOC 2 report, data handling summary, SSO/SCIM timeline.
- Typical procurement timeline once legal signs (lead times for PO + invoice).

Can you share a MAP that maps evaluation completion to contract gates and who on your side owns each item? I can loop in our finance lead (Jordan) but wanted to start with a concise plan.

Also flagged: we may need a short SLA exception for a 99.9% latency SLO for some of our workloads — is that something Redwood has handled as an exception before?

Thanks,
Amelia Torres
Sr. Procurement Manager
Cardinal Diagnostics

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Torres <amelia.torres@cardinaldx.com>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@cardinaldx.com>, procurement@cardinaldx.com, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP request & gating questions for purchase

On Tue, Dec 1, 2026 at 9:12 AM Amelia Torres <amelia.torres@cardinaldx.com> wrote:
> Neha — thanks again for the demo yesterday...

Hi Amelia — really appreciate the clarity. Attaching a working MAP (Cardinal_MAP_v3.xlsx) that aligns evaluation milestones to legal/procurement gates and owners. High level summary below and next steps.

Summary of the proposed sequencing (short):
- Evaluation run (PoC validation) — owner: Cardinal (technical lead) + Redwood PD (Neha) — target: 2 weeks.
- Security evidence review (SOC 2, pen test summary) — owner: Redwood security (Karthik coordinating) — deliver by day 3 of PoC start.
- MSA negotiation & DPA acceptance — parallel track: legal redlines to be resolved within 7 business days after initial redline exchange.
- Order form / PO submission — once both MSA & DPA are agreed, Cardinal issues PO; Redwood to provide final order form for signature.
- Activation / onboarding kickoff — target 3 business days after signed order form.

Notes on SLA exception: We can put a latency SLO carve-out in the order form as an appendix; Karthik will confirm feasibility and required pricing uplift.

Immediate asks from your side:
1) Confirm evaluation owner and target start date.
2) Confirm if procurement requires a DocuSign workflow or local paper PO.
3) Any internal approval deadlines (leadership sign-off date) for this week.

Attaching: Cardinal_MAP_v3.xlsx (workbook with tasks, owners, dates), plus a short doc listing typical SLA exceptions. I also added a DocuSign placeholder link in the sheet in case you prefer e-signature.

Thanks — I’ll hand legal sequencing to Karthik for details.

—
Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0121

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Amelia Torres <amelia.torres@cardinaldx.com>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@cardinaldx.com>, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 14:26:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP request & gating questions for purchase

Amelia / team — adding detail on sequencing and what legal needs to avoid last-minute stalls.

Key legal sequencing recommendation (practical):
1) Exchange MSA redlines early — please send Cardinal redlines to me directly (karthik.iyer@redwood.ai). We will do a technical/legal split: any technical controls will be handled by the security workbook, pure contract terms by legal.
2) Leave DPA as a separate signature instrument if you prefer (we can sign DPA concurrently with MSA). This avoids blocking order form acceptance.
3) Order form must reference the MSA effective date but does not need to wait for PO issuance to start onboarding discussion — we can accept a signed order form + forthcoming PO in finance.

Gating items that typically cause delay: indemnity caps, data-subject flow clarifications, SSO/SCIM provisioning window, and data residency confirmations. If Cardinal can pre-approve standard indemnity limits and confirm data residency needs upfront, we cut 5-7 business days.

Pricing / SLA exception: we can do a temporary latency SLO exception appended as an Order Form exhibit; that requires an explicit term for pricing uplift and a sunset (30–90 days). I can draft the exhibit once you confirm the acceptable uplift band.

I’ll attach model language and a short sequencing timeline into the MAP workbook and mark legal-owned rows.

—
Karthik Iyer
Legal Operations Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Torres <amelia.torres@cardinaldx.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@cardinaldx.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 09:41:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP request & gating questions for purchase

Amelia — quick note from CS/procurement ops perspective.

We prefer DocuSign for the order form + MSA for speed, but we can accept a local PO afterwards. If procurement issues a PO, please include the exact billing name and address; our finance team needs the remit-to to match. Typical flow: signed order form -> PO within 2 business days -> invoice issued next business day -> onboarding slot scheduled.

I added a checklist in the MAP workbook: billing info, required tax forms (W-9 or equivalent), SSO contact for SCIM provisioning, and a 2-week window to provision test accounts. If Cardinal needs SOC 2 in PDF form, we can provide the latest report under NDA (link added to the attached security sheet).

If it helps, I can run a 20-minute call Monday to walk Jordan through the DocuSign steps and the billing fields to avoid rework.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0456

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Amelia Torres <amelia.torres@cardinaldx.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@cardinaldx.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP request & gating questions for purchase

Thanks all — quick executive confirmation on sequencing and escalation lanes.

We approve the MAP approach and parallel tracks (PoC + concurrent legal). Two items for escalation if dates slip:
- If MSA redlines are not closed within 10 business days, escalate to me for prioritization.
- If onboarding is delayed beyond 7 business days after signed order form, we will temporarily provision a staging seat under an interim acceptance memoire to keep the PoC running while finance finalizes PO.

Amelia — I’ll stay on the thread in case any leadership-level tradeoffs are required. Please confirm your preferred start date for the PoC and whether you want the DocuSign workflow enabled; if yes, we’ll send the DocuSign package by EOD tomorrow.

—
Markus Klein
VP, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
